summary: bioAffinity Technologies filed an 8-K reporting that on September 8, 2026, Nasdaq's Listing Qualifications Staff confirmed the company regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule (Listing Rule 5550(a)(2)) and the Rights/Warrants Rule (5560(a)). The company had received a July 30, 2026 staff determination of non-compliance covering June 16–July 29, 2026, and was ineligible for the standard 180-day cure period due to a reverse split within the prior year. An August 6 appeal and September 8 hearing were rendered moot; the hearing was cancelled and BIAF/BIAFW continue listed.
